summary: Phase 7 Checkpoint 1 frontend shell fully tested via Playwright at http://localhost:3000. All 10 required flows PASS: super_admin login->/admin with 4 permission-gated stat tiles rendering real API values (students=1, admissions=0, examinations=3, documents=24); admission_officer login shows only 2 tiles (students, admissions) — permission gating works; Alice Wonder student login->/portal with registration_number=KWI/REG/2026/000001 and enrollments=2; route guards work in all four directions (logged-out /admin & /portal -> /login; student /admin -> /portal; staff /portal -> /admin); session persists after hard reload via GET /api/auth/me + httpOnly cookie; logout clears server-side session (post-logout /admin -> /login); wrong password shows inline error 'Invalid email or password' via [data-testid=login-error]; mobile viewport (400px) hides sidebar and shows hamburger, sheet slide-out reveals nav; CSRF X-CSRF-Token header confirmed present on POST /api/auth/logout (captured token value in network layer).

issues: Radix Dialog console warning: 'DialogContent requires a DialogTitle for the component to be accessible for screen reader users' and 'Missing Description or aria-describedby'. Fix: add a VisuallyHidden SheetTitle/SheetDescription inside SheetContent. A11y-only, not functional.

action_items: (Optional a11y polish) Add VisuallyHidden SheetTitle + SheetDescription inside the mobile SheetContent in /app/frontend/src/components/layout/AppLayout.jsx to silence the Radix Dialog a11y warning. Non-blocking for Checkpoint 1 approval.
critical_code_review_comments: AdminDashboardPage StatCard fetches the ENTIRE list from /students, /admissions, /examinations, /documents just to display .length. This is fine at current seed sizes (max 24 docs) but will not scale — should switch to lightweight count endpoints (or ?limit=1 + total header) in a later checkpoint.

AuthContext.login() calls applySession with empty perms=[] before refresh() rehydrates them. There is a brief window where a just-logged-in user has permissions=[] which would hide all permission-gated tiles. In practice this resolves in ms because refresh() awaits, but is technically a flicker risk — consider skipping the intermediate applySession call.

LoginPage handleSubmit uses location.state?.from?.pathname as redirect target without validating the role can access it — student redirected to a saved /admin from-state would bounce twice (login->/admin->ProtectedRoute->/portal). Not broken (ProtectedRoute catches it) but ugly redirect chain. The isStudent guard partially mitigates. Fine for shell.
Frontend axios baseURL '/api' is correct for Hostinger same-origin and craco proxy — matches user's explicit requirement. No REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL usage (intentional per problem statement).
